title: Hidden Side of Shenzhen: Exploring Wanxia Urban Village
description: Dive into Shenzhen’s lesser-known Wanxia Urban Village, where narrow alleys, dense buildings, and lively markets clash with the city’s modern skyline. Discover resilient community life of urban village with Xintong Chen. Find a hidden world within a futuristic metropolis.
